bd-4eze CLOSED. Commit 8ecaf94 (beads only). Code changes in working tree (uncommitted, for orchestrator review): crates/toron-core/src/backend/herdr.rs + mock.rs + new fixture crates/toron-core/tests/fixtures/herdr-schema-v19.json.

Summary:
- HDR_PROTOCOL 18->19 (herdr.rs:29), doc comments updated (herdr.rs, error.rs, types.rs).
- PaneInfo conformed field-for-field to live v19: +terminal_id, +workspace_id, +tab_id, +focused, agent_status now non-Option, +revision, +agent_session/scroll/label/terminal_title_stripped/tokens/state_labels/display_agent/foreground_cwd; new AgentSessionInfo + PaneScrollInfo structs.
- WorktreeInfo conformed: worktree_id/workspace_id removed -> path + is_bare/is_detached/is_prunable/is_linked_worktree + label (required) + branch/open_workspace_id (Option).
- TDD fixture tests: protocol pin vs fixture, live payload parses for pane/worktree/agent/workspace, schema field-requirements guard. 17 backend tests green.
- Full toron-core suite: 323 passed, 3 FAILED — all bd-5icg read-state tests (test_acknowledge_also_marks_read, test_mark_read_excludes_from_unread_only_fetch, test_read_state_survives_restart) — Crew 2 in-flight, NOT mine, not in my reservation.
- flywheel verify-0001.sh: PASSED (gate green — was the P0 blocker).
- Live round-trip passed: agent.list/workspace.list/pane.list through typed client against running daemon (test live_round_trip_v19, #[ignore]d by default).
- clippy -D warnings: 2 PRE-EXISTING errors in untouched files (mailbox/surface.rs:324 collapsible-if, mailbox/mod.rs:177 collapsible-if); zero from this change.

Note for Crew 2 (bd-5icg): your in-flight messaging.rs edit briefly broke tree compile (E0063 missing read_ts_us at inbox_from initializer) around 09:04; resolved by 09:06. Your 3 new tests currently FAIL in-tree.
